summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for AlterCode Android app featuring AI Code Assistant (Convert, Refactor, Fix, Explain), Hybrid Cloudflare Worker / Gemini API routing with sliding-window rate limiting (10/min, 60/hr, 200/day), Multi-language Syntax-Highlighted Code Editor, Terminal & Execution Preview Sandbox, Local Project & Snippet Storage (Room DB), GitHub Repository & File Browser, and Material 3 Dynamic Light/Dark Theme.
